tasks.title: Set up PostgreSQL database schema with tables for users, flowers, categories, orders, cart_items, and addresses
Implement React Native mobile app foundation with navigation structure and bottom tab navigation (Home, Categories, Orders, Profile)
Design and implement Home Screen UI with search bar, featured banner, category cards, and popular flowers grid following design specifications
Build Node.js/Express REST API endpoints for flower catalog browsing (GET /flowers, GET /categories, GET /flowers/:id)
Implement Flower Detail Screen with image gallery, description, quantity selector, and add-to-cart functionality
Create Shopping Cart Screen with cart management (add, update quantity, remove items) and price breakdown display
Integrate Stripe API for payment processing in checkout flow with secure token handling
Build Checkout Screen with delivery address input, date selector, payment method selection, and order placement
Implement AWS S3 integration for flower image storage and retrieval with optimized loading
Create Order Tracking Screen with status timeline, estimated arrival display, and real-time updates
Integrate SendGrid for order confirmation and delivery notification emails
Design and implement Profile Screen with order history, saved addresses, payment methods, and settings menu
Build Admin Inventory Management interface for adding/updating flowers, pricing, and stock levels
Implement authentication and authorization system with JWT tokens for Customer and Admin roles
Create reusable UI component library (buttons, cards, inputs, modals) following design system specifications

risks: Stripe API integration complexity may cause payment processing delays if not properly tested in sandbox environment
AWS S3 image loading performance could impact user experience if not optimized with caching and CDN
Real-time order tracking implementation may require additional infrastructure for WebSocket connections or polling mechanisms
Database schema changes during development could require migration scripts and data integrity management
Third-party API rate limits (Stripe, SendGrid) may restrict testing and require careful quota management
